prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1268; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The front bumper cover is cracked and the grille support has bent inward, with the hood latch and radiator core support showing deformation consistent with a frontal strike. Headlamp assembly and fog lamp housing are broken on the driver side, and the radiator shows minor fin damage without leaks. The damage pattern lines up well with the impact as described. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, grille, hood latch, and headlamp, straightening the core support, and performing a wheel alignment and sensor recalibration. The labor hours fit the scope of this work. Billing shows no repeated charges, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known.
